QUESTION:
A sample of nuclei X contains 48×10^23 nuclei at some time and reduced to 6×10^23 nuclei in 3 minutes. The mean life of nucleus X is roughly?

(A) 0.693 min
(B) 1.44 min
(C) 2.079 min
(D) 4.329 min

STORED ANSWER KEY: ["", "B"]

STORED SOLUTION:
A sample of nuclei decreases from 48 × 10^23 to 6 × 10^23 in 3 minutes.

Radioactive decay law: N = N_0e^(− t/τ)

Here N/(N_0) = 6/48 = 1/8 so N/(N_0) = e^(− t/τ) = 1/8

Taking natural logarithm: ln(1/8) = − t/τ so t/τ = ln(8) and therefore τ = t/(ln⁡(8)) .

Since t = 3min and ln(8) = ln(2^3) = 3ln(2) ≈ 2.079 we get τ = 3/2.079 ≈ 1.44min .

Hence the mean life of the nucleus is τ ≈ 1.44min .
